EPFO New Rules 2026: Will your PF savings now give you a monthly income after retirement?
In a major development, EPFO's Central Board of Trustees has approved the Systematic Withdrawal Plan (SWP), allowing retirees to receive their provident fund savings in regular instalments instead of withdrawing the entire amount at once.
But how will EPFO's new SWP work? Can ₹30 lakh in PF generate approximately ₹20,000 per month? Will the remaining balance continue to earn 8.25% interest?
